content.text: The Riviera Country Club • Pacific Palisades, Calif. • June 4-7, 2026 Sign InSign In U.S. Women's Open Presented by Ally The Riviera Country Club • Pacific Palisades, Calif. • June 4-7, 2026 11 Past Champs Among 1,897 Entries for 81st U.S. Women's Open Presented by AllyEleven past champions, including 2025 winner Maja Stark, are among the 1,897 competitors who have entered the 2026 U.S. Women's Open Presented by Ally.READ11 Past Champs Among 1,897 Entries for 81st U.S. Women's Open Presented by AllyEleven past champions, including 2025 winner Maja Stark, are among the 1,897 competitors who have entered the 2026 U.S. Women's Open Presented by Ally.READ 11 Past Champs Among 1,897 Entries for 81st U.S. Women's Open Presented by AllyREAD Daily Tickets Now AvailableBUY TICKETS Sun Cruiser Official Ready-to-Drink Cocktail of U.S. Women's OpenREAD Sixth Sense: Riviera Country Club's Unique Par 3READNext: Daily Tickets Now Available Did You Know? Data Rights Request If you have an opt-out preference signal enabled on your browser or device, USGA will seek to honor this signal as a browser-level opt-out, and “Your Opt-Out Preference Signal is Honored” should appear. Clearing your cookies on your browser or device at any time may undo the cookie preferences saved here and reenable cookies through this website. To re-save your cookie preferences for this website after clearing your cookies, please return to this Cookie Preference Center and select your preferences. Please note that your preferences may not be saved if you are using a private mode in your web browser. For additional information about how the USGA collects, uses, and shares your information, and the choices that the USGA makes available to you, please read our USGA Privacy Policy. USGA Privacy PolicyStrictly NecessaryAlways ActiveThese cookies are necessary for the website to function and cannot be switched off in our systems. They are usually only set in response to actions made by you which amount to a request for services, such as setting your privacy preferences, logging in or filling in forms. You can set your browser to block or alert you about these cookies, but some parts of the site will not then work. These cookies do not store any personally identifiable information.Functional Functional These cookies enable the website to provide enhanced functionality and personalisation. They may be set by us or by third party providers whose services we have added to our pages. If you do not allow these cookies then some or all of these services may not function properly.Performance Performance These cookies allow us to count visits and traffic sources so we can measure and improve the performance of our site. They help us to know which pages are the most and least popular and see how visitors move around the site. All information these cookies collect is aggregated and therefore anonymous. If you do not allow these cookies we will not know when you have visited our site, and will not be able to monitor its performance.Marketing and Advertising Cookies Marketing and Advertising Cookies These cookies may be set through our website by our advertising partners. They may be used by those companies to build a profile of your interests and show you relevant advertisements on other sites. They do not store directly personal information but are based on uniquely identifying your browser and internet device. If you do not allow these cookies, you will experience less targeted advertising. You will still see ads but they may be less relevant to you.
